description: Returns every retained version of a slug owned by the token, newest first. Inputs: slug and token. Each entry includes version, created_at, file_count, bytes, kind (publish, merge, or restore), restored_from, and a public permalink. A retained version's URL stays stable while that version is kept and the site is available. Free keeps the last 10 versions, Hobby 50, and Pro has no cap, including the live version, applied when a new version is saved. Pruning, deleting that version, or deleting the site removes it. A cache can briefly still serve a removed URL, and publishing the same slug again can reuse the v1 URL. It is not a permanent archive.

token.description: Bearer token returned by your first publish (deed_tok_...). Optional if the MCP client sends Authorization: Bearer.
